whyPressure: the system's memory pressure level is {pressure}
whyCompressor: the memory compressor is nearly full ({seg_pct}% of its limit)
whySwapin: {swapin_mb_min}MB a minute is being swapped back in from disk (thrashing)
whyFroze: the computer froze {times} time(s) in the last 10 minutes (the patrol ran {gap} seconds late)
whyDisk: the system disk has only {disk_gb}GB left (swap grows on it, and a full disk freezes the computer: move big files to an external disk and delete worktrees that are handed in)
brief: Machine load: {level} | {avail_pct}% available, compressor {comp_gb}GB ({seg_pct}% of its limit), swap {swap_gb}GB, disk {disk_gb}GB free, load {load1}/{ncpu} cores | you hold {mine_gb}GB (compressed included){top}
lightRefused: A light code task is refused.
lightAllowed: Only a light code task by one worker may start; no audio or video processing.
gateCooldown: {kind} was just closed automatically because memory was in danger; it is cooling down for {left} more minutes. {brief}
gateDanger: Memory is in danger: start no new heavy work until it comes down (or close what you are not using). {brief}
gateJustBooted: The computer booted {minutes} minutes ago and its services are still starting; the phone can start once it has been up for 15 minutes. {brief}
gateUnsteady: Memory has not been steady in the last 3 minutes (not every patrol was normal): the phone stays off for now. {brief}
gateMediaRunning: {what} is running; the phone (about 4GB) on top of it would push memory into danger, so the phone starts by itself once that is done. {brief}
gateMediaQuiet: A big whisper/ffmpeg job was still running {seconds} seconds ago (it looks like a batch in pieces); the phone starts by itself after {minutes} quiet minutes. {brief}
gateTight: Memory is tight and {kind} takes too much (about {need}GB): not now. {brief}
gateNoRoom: Not enough room: after the {reserve:.1f}GB kept for the system and {owner} only {left}GB is left, and {kind} needs {need}GB. {brief}
freeLibretv: the LibreTV container (docker start libretv when you want it back)
roomFreed: Made room first: closed {list}. There is enough now. {brief}
roomDanger: memory is at the danger line ({list}); starting it now would freeze the whole computer
roomShort: about {short:.1f}GB short ({kind} needs {need}GB of room; the {reserve:.1f}GB of the system and {owner} stays untouched)
roomYours:
What you hold in memory now (you decide what to close):
{list}
roomHow: How to close: for Claude Code sessions, helper ls shows which are running and helper stop <name> stops one that can wait; kill <pid> for videos and scripts; for the browser, first make sure no helper is uploading or filling a form with it, then kill its main process. Then try again.
shedPhone: closed the phone emulator (it takes the most memory); the senses will not start it again by themselves for 30 minutes (start it yourself whenever you need it)
shedBiggest: ended your biggest heavy process: {name} (pid {pid}, {gb}.{tenth}GB). It did not finish; it was stopped, and what it wrote may be incomplete: {cmd}
shedRunaway: ended {name} (pid {pid}, {gb}.{tenth}GB): this one process had grown bigger than the computer's whole memory ({total}GB), and the computer would have frozen had it kept growing. It did not finish; it was stopped, and what it wrote may be incomplete: {cmd}
notifyOwner: Memory has been in danger for {streak} minutes. Everything {me} could close is closed; most of the memory is held on your side ({others}). Left alone, the computer may freeze. {why}
shedEvent: Memory is at {level}; load was shed automatically: {did} ({at})
showRoom: Room before heavy work: {room}GB (the {reserve:.1f}GB kept for the system and {owner} is already taken off). The phone needs 3GB of room (when short, load room phone shows how much to free); ffmpeg/whisper/a batch about 1GB; in danger the heavy way is not started; for light code work start the helper with --light.
senseNote.load: the machine ran dangerously short of memory and load was shed (the phone stopped, the biggest heavy job ended)
wizardAbout: Watches this Mac's load and memory, and holds heavy work back when they run tight.
